models.name: discussion_board_categories
models.description: Categories for organizing published articles. Each category represents a primary organizational bucket (e.g., Economics, Policy, Commentary). Categories are independently managed by administrators and referenced by articles via a primary_category_id in the Content component. Contains activation flags and temporal audit fields for lifecycle management. Recommended: add DB-level defaults for created_at and updated_at and consider case-insensitive uniqueness for slug if desired.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable category name used in listings and UI (e.g., 'Economics').

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly unique identifier for category (e.g., 'economics'). Consider enforcing lower-case uniqueness (citext or functional index lower(slug)).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer description explaining the category's scope and usage guidance.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether the category is active and available for assignment to new articles.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Optional integer used to order categories in curated lists; lower values appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. Recommendation: add DB default @default(now()) to ensure value at insert.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp. Recommendation: use Prisma's @updatedAt or DB trigger to keep this current; otherwise add @default(now()) and application must update on changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: discussion_board_tags
models.description: Tag catalogue for articles. Tags provide flexible, many-to-many labeling for articles to aid discovery and search. Tags are managed independently and may be applied to multiple articles via the junction table {@link discussion_board_article_tags}. Recommended: add DB-level defaults for created_at and updated_at; consider case-insensitive slug uniqueness if product requires it.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Tag display name (e.g., 'inflation').

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly unique tag key (e.g., 'inflation'). Consider enforcing lower-case uniqueness (citext or functional index lower(slug)).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description or guidance for tag usage.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether the tag is currently active and assignable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. Recommendation: add DB default @default(now()).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp. Recommendation: add @updatedAt or DB trigger to maintain this value.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: discussion_board_article_tags
models.description: Junction table implementing the many-to-many relationship between articles and tags. Each row links one article (existing {@link discussion_board_articles.id}) to one tag ({@link discussion_board_tags.id}). Composite uniqueness prevents duplicate tag assignments per article. Recommendation: add created_at DB default @default(now()).

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced article. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_tag_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced tag. {@link discussion_board_tags.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Link creation timestamp. Recommendation: add DB default @default(now()).

plainFields.name: created_by_member_id
plainFields.description: Optional actor (member) who created the tag assignment; references {@link discussion_board_member.id} in other components.

models.name: discussion_board_settings
models.description: Global key/value configuration entries used by the application for runtime feature flags, thresholds, and SLO parameters. Settings are managed by administrators and read by other components at runtime. Keys are unique business identifiers. Recommendation: add created_at/updated_at DB defaults and consider jsonb for structured values if necessary.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique settings key (e.g., 'moderation.auto_hide_report_threshold').

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Settings value stored as string; consumer interprets type (boolean, number, JSON) as needed. Consider jsonb if structured queries are necessary.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-friendly description explaining purpose of the setting.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether the setting entry is active and should be considered by runtime code.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. Recommendation: add DB default @default(now()).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp. Recommendation: add @updatedAt or equivalent mechanism.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: discussion_board_guest
models.description: Guest identity record for transient or tracked visitors. Stores minimal attribution for anonymous or pseudo-guest actors when the system requires a persisted guest entity (for example, to track pre-authored drafts or anonymous report tracking). Guests are lightweight actors and are primarily used for audit correlation and temporary workflows. Related actor tables: {@link discussion_board_member}, {@link discussion_board_moderator}.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name supplied by the guest for a short-lived contribution or draft.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed when the guest session or action was recorded.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for guest record (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for guest records (nullable).

models.name: discussion_board_member
models.description: Member accounts for authenticated users. Contains credentials and profile fields required for publishing, commenting, subscriptions and notification preferences. Members must verify email before gaining publishing privileges; verification artifacts are stored in {@link discussion_board_email_verifications}. Passwords are stored as hashes only (password_hash).

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Unique username chosen by the member.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Verified email address for account recovery and notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash (never store plain text).

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name shown publicly.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Actor role identifier (e.g., 'USER'). Use application-level enum enforcement; stored as string.

plainFields.name: mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether the member has enabled MFA (true/false).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp (nullable) to enable recovery workflows.

models.name: discussion_board_moderator
models.description: Moderator accounts with elevated privileges for reviewing reports, taking moderation actions, and accessing moderation audit trails. Moderators are distinct actor records to clearly separate permissions and auditing from regular members.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Unique moderator username.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Moderator contact email.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for moderator login.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Moderator display name for audit records.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Moderator account creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for moderator account (nullable).

models.name: discussion_board_member_sessions
models.description: Session records for members. Follows the required per-actor session table pattern: minimal connection context (ip, href, referrer), created_at and expired_at timestamps. Composite index on (discussion_board_member_id, created_at) is used for efficient session lifecycle queries.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link discussion_board_member.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address for the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL (referring href) for the session context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiry time (nullable when session is open-ended until revoked).

models.name: discussion_board_moderator_sessions
models.description: Session records for moderators. Mirrors member session table structure and provides auditability for privileged sessions. Composite index on (discussion_board_moderator_id, created_at) supports session listing and revocation workflows.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged moderator's {@link discussion_board_moderator.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address observed for the moderator session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL for the moderator session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the moderator session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiry time (nullable).

models.name: discussion_board_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for members. Stores single-use verification tokens with expiration and consumption timestamps. Tokens are unique and tied to a member account for verification flows.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Target member for the verification token. {@link discussion_board_member.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique single-use verification token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Token issuance time (UTC).

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration time (UTC).

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: Time when the token was used (nullable).

models.name: discussion_board_password_resets
models.description: Password reset requests for members. Stores single-use reset tokens with expiry and consumption timestamps and limited context for security (request ip). Tokens are unique to prevent replay.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who requested password reset. {@link discussion_board_member.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique single-use password reset token.

plainFields.name: request_ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the reset was requested.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Reset request timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Reset token expiration time (UTC).

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: Time the token was consumed (nullable).

models.name: discussion_board_articles
models.description: Primary articles posted by members. Stores current live state for each post and references the owning member and optional primary category. Author FK uses ON DELETE SET NULL to preserve article content when member accounts are anonymized or removed; published_at is recorded separately to support edit windows and publication visibility semantics. Contains temporal audit fields and indexes for listing and moderation workloads. {@link discussion_board_member.id} {@link discussion_board_categories.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Authoring member. {@link discussion_board_member.id}. Nullable to allow anonymization/set-null on account removal.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_category_id
foreignFields.description: Primary category for the article. {@link discussion_board_categories.id}. Nullable for uncategorized drafts.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title (business constraint: min 5, max 250 characters).

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Article body content. Store raw text/markdown; render sanitization is an application concern.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: Article lifecycle state: one of 'draft','published','pending_review','hidden'.

plainFields.name: is_pinned
plainFields.description: Whether the article is pinned in listings.

plainFields.name: published_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was published to public listings. Null for drafts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_attachments
models.description: Attachments uploaded for articles. Each attachment belongs to an article and optionally references the uploading member. Uploader FK uses ON DELETE SET NULL so attachments persist when the account is removed; application-level purge logic should remove storage objects when attachments are permanently purged. Attachments inherit parent retention windows and are indexed for article-based queries. {@link discussion_board_articles.id} {@link discussion_board_member.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged article. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}. This FK prevents orphan attachments; application purge must explicitly remove attachments before deleting articles.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Uploading member. {@link discussion_board_member.id}. Nullable to allow SET NULL when member accounts are anonymized or removed.

plainFields.name: original_filename
plainFields.description: Filename as provided by the uploader.

plainFields.name: storage_key
plainFields.description: Object storage key or path referencing the persisted file.

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the attachment.

plainFields.name: size
plainFields.description: File size in bytes.

plainFields.name: is_image
plainFields.description: Whether the attachment is an image (true) or not (false).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Upload timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for the attachment.

models.name: discussion_board_article_snapshots
models.description: Append-only snapshots capturing historical states of articles for audit and versioning. Relationship to article must NOT cascade deletes to preserve audit history. Use ON DELETE RESTRICT or an archive-first purge flow so snapshots survive accidental article removal. Each snapshot denormalizes article fields at snapshot time and is retained for compliance. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced article. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}. Application must ensure snapshots are preserved; DB-level FK should use ON DELETE RESTRICT or snapshot FK made nullable with explicit archival workflow.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Article content at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: State value captured at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: snapshot_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Original article creation time (denormalized).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Original article update time (denormalized).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Original article deleted_at value (denormalized).

models.name: discussion_board_comments
models.description: User comments on articles. Stores threaded replies via a self-referencing parent_comment_id and preserves author attribution while allowing account deletion (author nullable). Used for moderation, search, and comment listings tied to articles. This corrected model enforces SET NULL on author and parent relationships to preserve conversation history when accounts/parents are removed.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged article's {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_author_id
foreignFields.description: Comment author's {@link discussion_board_member.id}. Nullable to allow SET NULL when a member account is removed.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_parent_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Parent comment reference for threaded replies. {@link discussion_board_comments.id}. Nullable for root comments or when parent is deleted.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Comment body text. Application-enforced maximum length applies (e.g., 500-5000 chars depending on product policy). Used for full-text search.

plainFields.name: is_hidden
plainFields.description: Whether the comment is hidden by moderation or automated rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Null if not soft-deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_comment_attachments
models.description: Attachments associated with comments. Stores filename, storage key, mime type, size, quarantine flag and ownership metadata. The uploadedBy relation is nullable and uses SET NULL semantics on actor removal so attachments remain for audit and moderation even if uploader account is removed.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged comment's {@link discussion_board_comments.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_uploaded_by_id
foreignFields.description: Uploading member's {@link discussion_board_member.id}. Nullable to allow SET NULL when a member account is removed.

plainFields.name: original_filename
plainFields.description: User-provided filename for the attachment.

plainFields.name: storage_key
plainFields.description: Object storage key or path referencing the stored file (URI).

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: MIME type reported on upload.

plainFields.name: size
plainFields.description: File size in bytes.

plainFields.name: is_image
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the file is an image type.

plainFields.name: quarantined
plainFields.description: Whether the attachment is quarantined due to malware or policy violations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Upload timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).

models.name: discussion_board_reports
models.description: Member-submitted reports of content (articles, comments, attachments). Implements a typed polymorphic target reference (target_type + target_id) to support reporting across multiple content types. Records reporter identity, optional reporter session, reason category, optional explanation, processing status and timestamps. Used to queue moderation work and aggregate report counts for automated thresholds. {@link discussion_board_member.id}

foreignFields.name: reporter_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reporting member's {@link discussion_board_member.id}.

foreignFields.name: reporter_session_id
foreignFields.description: Reporting member session reference. {@link discussion_board_member_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Type of the reported target (e.g., 'article','comment','attachment'). Used with target_id to implement a polymorphic reference.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the reported target. Interpreted according to target_type.

plainFields.name: reason_category
plainFields.description: Report reason category (enum-like values: 'Spam','Harassment','Misinformation','Illegal','Other').

plainFields.name: explanation
plainFields.description: Optional reporter-provided explanation supporting the report (up to 1000 characters).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Processing status of the report (e.g., 'pending','triaged','resolved'). Application enforces allowed values.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Report creation timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when a moderator or automation first processed the report.

plainFields.name: closed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the report was resolved/closed.

models.name: discussion_board_moderation_actions
models.description: Actions taken by moderators in response to reports or proactive moderation (hide, remove, warn, suspend, ban). Links to the acting moderator and optional originating report. Captures action semantics (type, reason, duration) and timestamps for SLA and audit. {@link discussion_board_moderator.id} {@link discussion_board_reports.id}

foreignFields.name: moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Acting moderator's {@link discussion_board_moderator.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_report_id
foreignFields.description: Optional originating report reference. {@link discussion_board_reports.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of moderation action (e.g., 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban').

plainFields.name: action_reason
plainFields.description: Moderator-provided reason or short note describing rationale for the action.

plainFields.name: action_duration_days
plainFields.description: Optional duration (in days) for time-limited sanctions (e.g., suspension length). Null for permanent actions or non-duration actions.

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Polymorphic type of the action target (e.g., 'article','comment','member').

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the acted-upon resource; interpreted according to target_type.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Action creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Optional time when the action becomes effective.

plainFields.name: effective_until
plainFields.description: Optional end time for time-limited actions.

models.name: discussion_board_appeals
models.description: Appeals submitted by members contesting moderation outcomes. Each appeal references either a report or a moderation action (or both) and records the appellant, explanation, status, resolution metadata and timestamps. Appeals are processed by moderators and linked to audit entries. {@link discussion_board_member.id} {@link discussion_board_reports.id} {@link discussion_board_moderation_actions.id}

foreignFields.name: appellant_member_id
foreignFields.description: Appeal submitter's member id. {@link discussion_board_member.id}.

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Optional referenced moderation action. {@link discussion_board_moderation_actions.id}.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Optional referenced report that motivated the moderation action. {@link discussion_board_reports.id}.

plainFields.name: explanation
plainFields.description: Member-provided explanation for the appeal (up to 2000 characters).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Appeal processing status (e.g., 'pending','accepted','rejected').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Appeal submission timestamp.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the appeal was resolved.

plainFields.name: resolution_reason
plainFields.description: Moderator-provided resolution note describing the outcome.

models.name: discussion_board_moderation_audit
models.description: Append-only immutable audit entries capturing moderation-related events for compliance and investigations. Stores a canonical event_type, serialized event_payload (JSON as text), links to related moderation artifacts when available, and occurred_at for time-based queries. This model is append-only and intended for long-term retention. {@link discussion_board_moderation_actions.id} {@link discussion_board_reports.id}

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Linked moderation action if applicable. {@link discussion_board_moderation_actions.id}.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Linked report if applicable. {@link discussion_board_reports.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator or system actor responsible for the event. {@link discussion_board_moderator.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Canonical event type for the audit entry (e.g., 'report.filed','moderation.action','appeal.submitted').

plainFields.name: event_payload
plainFields.description: Serialized event payload (JSON stored as text) containing the full snapshot of the event for forensic reconstruction.

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audited event occurred.

models.name: discussion_board_subscriptions
models.description: Member subscriptions to posts or authors. Stores which member subscribed to which target (polymorphic by target_type + target_id), delivery preference (immediate or daily_digest), active flag, and temporal fields for auditing and soft-delete. Includes a uniqueness constraint to prevent duplicate subscriptions per member and target.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Owning member's {@link discussion_board_member.id}. The subscriber who created the subscription.

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Type of subscription target. Examples: "article", "author". Application enforces allowed values.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the target resource (article id or author/member id). Polymorphic target identifier; referential integrity enforced by application logic.

plainFields.name: delivery_mode
plainFields.description: Delivery preference for this subscription. Allowed values: "immediate", "daily_digest".

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the subscription is active and eligible to receive notifications.

plainFields.name: last_notified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last notification sent for this subscription (used for throttling/deduping).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when not deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_notifications
models.description: Queued notification messages targeted to members. Each record represents a delivery task produced by subscription events or direct notifications (mentions, system messages). Contains scheduling, delivery attempts, status, optional relation to article and originating subscription, and temporal fields for auditing. Managed by worker processes for delivery and retries.

foreignFields.name: recipient_member_id
foreignFields.description: Recipient member's {@link discussion_board_member.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_subscription_id
foreignFields.description: Originating subscription's {@link discussion_board_subscriptions.id}. Nullable when notification was created outside a subscription (e.g., mention).

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Optional related article {@link discussion_board_articles.id} that triggered the notification.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Notification type (e.g., "subscription_update", "mention", "system").

plainFields.name: payload
plainFields.description: Opaque JSON payload or small text describing the notification content. Application enforces size limits.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Delivery status: "pending", "sent", or "failed".

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Delivery priority, higher values indicate earlier processing.

plainFields.name: delivery_attempts
plainFields.description: Number of delivery attempts made.

plainFields.name: last_attempted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last delivery attempt.

plainFields.name: next_retry_at

plainFields.name: sent_at

plainFields.name: fail_reason
plainFields.description: Optional short failure reason from last attempt.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: discussion_board_notification_failures
models.description: Records of individual failed delivery attempts for notifications. Tracks attempt number, timestamp, error details and next backoff time to support retry scheduling and operational diagnostics. Each failure references a notification entry.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_notification_id
foreignFields.description: Related notification's {@link discussion_board_notifications.id}.

plainFields.name: attempt_number
plainFields.description: Sequential attempt number for this delivery (1-based).

plainFields.name: attempted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this delivery attempt occurred.

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: Optional short machine-readable error code from delivery channel.

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Human-readable error message captured from the delivery attempt.

plainFields.name: backoff_until
plainFields.description: If present, worker should not retry this notification until this timestamp (backoff/backpressure).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: discussion_board_audit_logs
models.description: Append-only audit log capturing system and user events for compliance and forensic analysis. Records generic events such as authentication events, moderation actions, exports, deletions and system events. Designed as a historical snapshot table: each row is a point-in-time immutable record describing an event. Uses polymorphic actor (actor_type + actor_id) and polymorphic resource references (resource_type + resource_id) to remain generic across domain objects. Retention, partitioning and access controls are expected to be implemented at operational level.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Categorized event type (e.g., "auth.login", "moderation.action", "export.request", "attachment.quarantine"). Use hierarchical dot notation for filtering and analytics.

plainFields.name: event_timestamp
plainFields.description: Exact time when the audited event occurred (ISO 8601 UTC).

plainFields.name: resource_type
plainFields.description: Logical type of the resource this event targets (e.g., "article", "comment", "attachment"). Nullable for system-level events with no resource.

plainFields.name: resource_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the target resource when applicable. Kept nullable to allow non-resource events.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor classification that performed the action (e.g., "member", "moderator", "system", "guest"). Use this field to route to the correct actor subtype if needed.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: Actor identifier (UUID) when applicable. Polymorphic; may reference a member, moderator or be null for system events.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Origin IP address observed for the event, if available.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent or client hint string captured at event time, if available.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Arbitrary JSON payload stored as text for event-specific details (searchable via full-text/GIN index). Keep structured JSON small to avoid row bloat.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record insertion time. For audit semantics this should be set by the application to match event_timestamp where possible.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last-update time. By policy audit records are append-only; updates should be exceptional and logged.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Nullable administrative soft-delete marker; production policy should restrict use and requires extra audit trail.

models.name: discussion_board_audit_log_accesses
models.description: Access audit for audit-log reads. Records every access to audit records for accountability: who accessed which audit record, when, from where and for what declared purpose. This table provides an immutable trail of access attempts and is designed as a snapshot (append-only) table for compliance queries.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_audit_log_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced audit log record. {@link discussion_board_audit_logs.id}.

plainFields.name: accessed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit record was accessed (ISO 8601 UTC).

plainFields.name: accessor_type
plainFields.description: Type of accessor (e.g., "moderator", "administrator", "system").

plainFields.name: accessor_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the accessor when applicable (polymorphic reference to member/moderator account).

plainFields.name: accessor_role
plainFields.description: Accessor role at time of access (e.g., "moderator", "audit_viewer"). Useful for retrospective RBAC checks.

plainFields.name: access_purpose
plainFields.description: Declared business reason for access (e.g., "appeal_review", "legal_request").

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of accessor session when available.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string of accessor session when available.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Optional JSON payload with contextual details about the access (e.g., query parameters, filters used).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record insertion time for the access event.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Nullable admin soft-delete marker. Use is restricted by policy.
